decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher sits in the core Multigraf line and costs little to keep as a distributor offering, so there is no reason to withdraw it.

The firm publicly staged a German premiere and presents the UV spot varnishing system as a flagship of its move into embellishment, so slow uptake can still be blamed on a market ramp-up and justifies persisting.
The sheet preparation module complements the modular systems, so dropping it would gain little and weaken the integrated offer.
The B2 multifinisher was announced on the home page as a flagship of the firm's automation direction and is tied to the core Duplo partnership, so strong public commitment favors keeping it.
The hybrid saddle stitcher is central to the booklet-making core and remains a natural part of the portfolio.
The folding add-on has a documented customer installation alongside the core creasing system, which supports keeping it.
